patterns_discovered.description: Implementation of a batch processing endpoint that handles multiple order IDs in a single request
patterns_discovered.usage: POST endpoint accepting JSON array of order IDs with size limits (max 100)

patterns_discovered.description: Uses Django transaction.atomic() to ensure all-or-nothing semantics for batch operations
patterns_discovered.usage: Prevents partial failures and maintains data consistency across multiple order updates

patterns_discovered.description: Handles both JSON body and form-encoded POST data with fallback mechanism
patterns_discovered.usage: Flexible input parsing: tries JSON first, falls back to POST array if JSON decode fails

patterns_discovered.description: Individual error collection per item without stopping batch processing
patterns_discovered.usage: Continues processing remaining orders even when individual ones fail, returns detailed error list

patterns_discovered.description: Uses @require_http_methods decorator to restrict endpoint to POST only
patterns_discovered.usage: Security-focused approach ensuring state changes only via POST, not GET

gotchas_discovered.issue: Initial JSON parsing may fail, requiring fallback to POST form data
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Try-except block with graceful fallback to request.POST.getlist()

gotchas_discovered.issue: Potential DoS vector if batch size validation (max 100) is bypassed
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Hard limit of 100 orders per request enforced before processing

gotchas_discovered.issue: Partial successes return success=true while having failed items
gotchas_discovered.design_decision: Returns started_count > 0 as success, allows caller to check error list for details

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Loose exception catching at outer level
gotchas_discovered.issue: Generic Exception catch at top level may mask unexpected issues during order processing
gotchas_discovered.context: Inner try-except blocks are specific, but outer exception handling is broad

gotchas_discovered.issue: String order_ids from request assumed to be valid UUIDs for ProductionOrder.objects.get()
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: DoesNotExist exception caught and reported per order, but invalid UUID format not explicitly handled

approach_outcome.summary: Successfully implemented production_order_batch_start view with comprehensive batch processing capabilities
approach_outcome.implementation_quality: High - includes transaction safety, detailed error handling, input validation, and dual format support
approach_outcome.deployment_readiness: Ready for deployment with proper testing of batch scenarios

recommendations.recommendation: Add explicit UUID format validation for order_ids before database lookup
recommendations.rationale: Current implementation relies on exception handling for invalid UUID strings; validation upfront would be cleaner
recommendations.implementation: Validate each order_id with uuid.UUID() before attempting ProductionOrder.objects.get()

recommendations.recommendation: Add unit tests for batch operation edge cases
recommendations.rationale: Test scenarios: empty list, single order, max batch (100), over-limit (>100), partial failures, all failures
recommendations.implementation: Create test_production_order_batch_start in test suite covering success and failure paths

recommendations.recommendation: Document the success=true behavior with partial failures in API response contract
recommendations.rationale: Callers need to know that started_count > 0 returns success=true even with failed items
recommendations.implementation: Add docstring clarifying response semantics and error list format

recommendations.recommendation: Consider adding rate limiting to prevent batch operation abuse
recommendations.rationale: No apparent rate limiting on batch endpoint; 100 order limit insufficient against repeated requests
recommendations.implementation: Apply django-ratelimit or similar decorator to control batch operation frequency

recommendations.recommendation: Use consistent internationalization for Portuguese error messages
recommendations.rationale: Current messages are in Portuguese; should use Django i18n framework for multi-language support
recommendations.implementation: Wrap all user-facing strings with gettext_lazy() and translation marks

recommendations.recommendation: Extract batch processing logic into a service layer method
recommendations.rationale: 81-line view function mixing request handling with business logic; could be cleaner
